verses.english: Numbered Discourses 7.35
4. Deities
Easy to Admonish (2nd)

verses.pali: “Imaṁ, bhikkhave, rattiṁ aññatarā devatā abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā …pe…
verses.english: “Mendicants, tonight a deity … said to me:
‘Sir, these seven things don’t lead to the decline of a mendicant trainee.
What seven?

verses.pali: Satthugāravatā, dhammagāravatā, saṅghagāravatā, sikkhāgāravatā, samādhigāravatā, sovacassatā, kalyāṇamittatā.
verses.english: Respect for the Teacher, for the teaching, for the Saṅgha, for the training, for immersion; being easy to admonish, and good friendship.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhante, satta dhammā bhikkhuno aparihānāya saṁvattantī’ti.
verses.english: These seven things don’t lead to the decline of a mendicant trainee.’
That is what that deity said.

verses.pali: Idaṁ vatvā maṁ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṁ katvā tatthevantaradhāyī”ti.
verses.english: Then he bowed and respectfully circled me, keeping me on his right side, before vanishing right there.”

verses.pali: Evaṁ vutte, āyasmā sāriputto bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: When he said this, Venerable Sāriputta said to the Buddha:

verses.pali: “imassa kho ahaṁ, bhante, bhagavatā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṁ vitthārena atthaṁ ājānāmi.
verses.english: “Sir, this is how I understand the detailed meaning of the Buddha’s brief statement.

verses.pali: Idha, bhante, bhikkhu attanā ca satthugāravo hoti, satthugāravatāya ca vaṇṇavādī.
verses.english: It’s when a mendicant personally respects the Teacher and praises such respect.

verses.pali: Ye caññe bhikkhū na satthugāravā te ca satthugāravatāya samādapeti.
verses.english: And they encourage other mendicants who lack such respect to respect the Teacher.

verses.pali: Ye caññe bhikkhū satthugāravā tesañca vaṇṇaṁ bhaṇati bhūtaṁ tacchaṁ kālena.
verses.english: And they praise other mendicants who respect the Teacher at the right time, truthfully and correctly.
They personally respect the teaching …
They personally respect the Saṅgha …
They personally respect the training …
They personally respect immersion …
They are personally easy to admonish …
They personally have good friends, and praise such friendship.

verses.pali: Ye caññe bhikkhū na kalyāṇamittā te ca kalyāṇamittatāya samādapeti.
verses.english: And they encourage other mendicants who lack good friends to develop good friendship.

verses.pali: Ye caññe bhikkhū kalyāṇamittā tesañca vaṇṇaṁ bhaṇati bhūtaṁ tacchaṁ kālenāti.
verses.english: And they praise other mendicants who have good friends at the right time, truthfully and correctly.

verses.pali: Imassa kho ahaṁ, bhante, bhagavatā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṁ vitthārena atthaṁ ājānāmī”ti.
verses.english: That’s how I understand the detailed meaning of the Buddha’s brief statement.”
“Good, good, Sāriputta!

verses.pali: Sādhu kho tvaṁ, sāriputta, imassa mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṁ vitthārena atthaṁ ājānāsi.
verses.english: It’s good that you understand the detailed meaning of what I’ve said in brief like this.

verses.pali: Idha, sāriputta, bhikkhu attanā ca satthugāravo hoti, satthugāravatāya ca vaṇṇavādī.
verses.english: It’s when a mendicant personally respects the Teacher …

verses.pali: Ye caññe bhikkhū na satthugāravā te ca satthugāravatāya samādapeti.
verses.english: And they encourage other mendicants who lack such respect to respect the Teacher.

verses.pali: Ye caññe bhikkhū satthugāravā tesañca vaṇṇaṁ bhaṇati bhūtaṁ tacchaṁ kālena.
verses.english: And they praise other mendicants who respect the Teacher at the right time, truthfully and correctly.
They personally respect the teaching …
They personally respect the Saṅgha …
They personally respect the training …
They personally respect immersion …
They are personally easy to admonish …
They personally have good friends, and praise such friendship.

verses.pali: Ye caññe bhikkhū na kalyāṇamittā te ca kalyāṇamittatāya samādapeti.
verses.english: And they encourage other mendicants who lack good friends to develop good friendship.

verses.pali: Ye caññe bhikkhū kalyāṇamittā tesañca vaṇṇaṁ bhaṇati bhūtaṁ tacchaṁ kālenāti.
verses.english: And they praise other mendicants who have good friends at the right time, truthfully and correctly.

verses.pali: Imassa kho, sāriputta, mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṁ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabbo”ti.
verses.english: This is how to understand the detailed meaning of what I said in brief.”
